body.name: Total common-Gaussian max-norm rectangle
body.construction: Let \(W^*\sim N(0,I_{|\mathcal J|})\) be independent of the data and set \(G^*=\Sigma(\widehat p_n)^{1/2}W^*\), using the principal positive-semidefinite square root. With the lower-quantile convention, set \(c_n=\inf\{t\in[0,\infty):\Pr\{T_n(G^*)\le t\mid\widehat p_n\}\ge1-\alpha\}\). If \(B_n=\varnothing\) or \(M(\widehat p_n)=0\), set \(C_n=\mathbb R^2\). Otherwise set \(C_n=\Phi_{\mathrm{ext}}(\widehat p_n)+[-c_n,c_n]^2/\sqrt n\). This full-plane branch is an honest finite-sample fallback, including \(M(\widehat p_n)=0\) with \(B_n\ne\varnothing\).
